prompt: I just signed up for my first HYROX race and don't want to spend much on a watch. What should I wear?

turns.prompt: I just signed up for my first HYROX race and don't want to spend much on a watch. What should I wear?
turns.answer:
Congrats on signing up for your first HYROX! My advice: don't spend a lot of money on a watch just for HYROX. You don't need an expensive Garmin, Apple Watch Ultra, or premium sports watch to finish your first race.

For HYROX, I'd prioritize three things:

Comfort: Something lightweight that won't bother you during sled pushes, burpee broad jumps, or wall balls.

Heart-rate tracking: Useful for learning how hard you're pushing, especially during the running sections.

Simple workout tracking: GPS, elapsed time, and lap splits are plenty for a first race.

You can also race without a watch. HYROX has its own timing system, so your official race time doesn't depend on your watch.

One important race-day caveat: the 2026/27 HYROX rulebook says unlisted items are prohibited by default, and watches aren't explicitly listed as permitted. Ask your event's race director for written permission before wearing one.
